answer: The ocean counter is kept in oasis and zephyr exposes each reset. Someone thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 524 identities would post 945 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
